parameters.name: methods
parameters.description: Finite set of candidate transportation methods, indexed by method index m with cardinality M

parameters.name: pollution_per_trip
parameters.description: Per-trip pollution generated by each transportation method

parameters.name: capacity_per_trip
parameters.description: Per-trip shipment capacity of each transportation method

parameters.name: trip_cap
parameters.description: Method-specific maximum allowed trips, when a finite cap exists; unlimited otherwise

parameters.name: selected_method_count
parameters.description: Exact number of transportation methods that must be selected

parameters.name: minimum_demand
parameters.description: Minimum total shipment volume that must be transported

parameters.name: maximum_total_trips
parameters.description: Upper bound on the total number of trips across all methods

variables.name: method_selected
variables.description: Binary selection variable indicating whether transportation method m is selected

variables.name: trips_assigned
variables.description: Nonnegative integer number of trips assigned to transportation method m

variables.name: total_pollution
variables.description: Total pollution of the chosen transportation plan

auxiliary_variables.name: total_pollution
auxiliary_variables.description: Total pollution of the chosen transportation plan, defined by the linear expression \(Z = \sum_{m \in \mathcal{M}} p_m x_m\)

constraints.name: exact_method_selection
constraints.description: Exactly K transportation methods must be selected

constraints.name: selection_usage_link
constraints.description: A transportation method may be assigned trips only if it is selected

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_trips
constraints.description: The number of trips assigned to each transportation method must be a nonnegative integer

constraints.name: method_trip_cap
constraints.description: Any finite method-specific trip limit must not be exceeded

constraints.name: total_trip_upper_bound
constraints.description: The total number of trips across all methods must not exceed U

constraints.name: minimum_transport_demand
constraints.description: The total transported quantity must be at least D

constraints.name: least_polluting_feasible_plan
constraints.description: Among feasible plans, choose the one with the least total pollution

objectives.name: total_pollution_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total pollution generated by all assigned trips in the transportation plan

final_objective.description: Minimize total pollution generated by all assigned trips in the single-period transportation plan.
